steps.command: mkdir -p /app/ssl && cd /app/ssl && openssl genrsa -out server.key 2048 && chmod 600 server.key && openssl req -new -x509 -key server.key -out server.crt -days 365 -subj "/O=DevOps Team/CN=dev-internal.company.local" && cat server.key server.crt > server.pem && chmod 644 server.crt server.pem

cd /app/ssl && { echo "Subject: $(openssl x509 -in server.crt -noout -subject | sed 's/^subject=//')"; echo "Validity:"; openssl x509 -in server.crt -noout -dates; echo "SHA256 Fingerprint: $(openssl x509 -in server.crt -noout -fingerprint -sha256 | sed 's/^.*=//')"; } > verification.txt && cat verification.txt && echo "---" && ls -l
python3 -c "import cryptography; print(cryptography.__version__)" 2>&1; python3 -c "import ssl; print(ssl.OPENSSL_VERSION)"

cd /app && chmod +x check_cert.py && python3 check_cert.py && echo "--- key/cert match ---" && diff <(openssl x509 -in ssl/server.crt -noout -pubkey) <(openssl pkey -in ssl/server.key -pubout) && echo MATCH && echo "--- combined pem ---" && grep -c "BEGIN" ssl/server.pem && openssl x509 -in ssl/server.pem -noout -subject && openssl rsa -in ssl/server.pem -check -noout

cd /app/ssl && { echo "Subject: $(openssl x509 -in server.crt -noout -subject | sed 's/^subject=//')"; echo "Not Before: $(openssl x509 -in server.crt -noout -startdate | sed 's/^notBefore=//')"; echo "Not After: $(openssl x509 -in server.crt -noout -enddate | sed 's/^notAfter=//')"; echo "SHA256 Fingerprint: $(openssl x509 -in server.crt -noout -fingerprint -sha256 | sed 's/^.*=//')"; } > verification.txt && cat verification.txt && echo "--- files ---" && ls -l /app/ssl /app/check_cert.py
